components.name: HTTP handler layer
components.responsibility: Route POST /links (create) and GET /{code} (follow); parse request, build responses, map errors to 400/404/302.
components.notes: Python stdlib only (http.server/BaseHTTPRequestHandler or equivalent). No framework.

components.name: URL validator
components.responsibility: Accept only absolute http/https URLs; reject missing/empty/non-absolute/other-scheme values.
components.notes: Pure function; no network calls (offline constraint).

components.name: Code generator
components.responsibility: Produce 7-character base62 codes; retry on collision until an unused code is found.
components.notes: Alphabet and retry limit are implementer choices per assumptions.

components.name: Link store (SQLite)
components.responsibility: Persist code->long_url mapping; enforce uniqueness of code; survive restarts; create schema on first start.
components.notes: UNIQUE constraint on code is the collision authority; file path is implementer choice.

components.name: Response builder
components.responsibility: Return short URL (absolute from request host or path) in a copyable form; set Location header on redirect.
components.notes: Form of returned short URL is implementer choice per assumptions.

interfaces.name: POST /links
interfaces.input: Long URL as form field or JSON body (shape is implementer choice).
interfaces.output: Success: short URL (absolute or path). Failure: 400 with no link created.
interfaces.errors: 400 for missing/empty URL; 400 for non-absolute or non-http(s) URL.

interfaces.name: GET /{code}
interfaces.output: 302 with Location = stored long URL. 404 if code unknown.
interfaces.errors: 404 for unknown code; no redirect issued.

dataFlow: Create: client POST /links -> handler parses body -> validator checks absolute http/https -> generator produces 7-char base62 code -> store.insert with UNIQUE(code); on collision, regenerate and retry -> response builder returns short URL. Follow: client GET /{code} -> handler -> store.lookup(code) -> if found, 302 with Location=long_url; if not, 404. No click data is written or read on follow. Persistence: SQLite file holds code->long_url; schema created on startup if absent; same file reused across restarts.

decisions.decision: Use SQLite UNIQUE constraint on code as the single source of truth for collision handling.
decisions.rationale: Satisfies S-3-1, S-3-2, and the concurrency assumption without application-level locking.

decisions.decision: Generate codes randomly (7 base62 chars) and retry on collision rather than using a counter or hash.
decisions.rationale: Meets S-1-1 (7 base62 chars) and S-1-2 (same URL twice yields two distinct short URLs).
alternatives: Hash of long URL truncated to 7 chars

decisions.decision: Validate URL with stdlib parsing only; require scheme in {http, https} and an absolute form.
decisions.rationale: Meets S-1-4, S-1-5, and the offline constraint (S-4-1); no DNS or network resolution.

decisions.decision: Follow path performs lookup and 302 only; no write of click/usage data.
decisions.rationale: Meets S-2-4 and keeps follow path read-only and fast.

decisions.decision: Create schema idempotently at startup against the configured SQLite file.

alternatives.rejectedBecause: Predictable and enumerable; also complicates S-1-2 semantics if dedup were attempted.
Same URL would map to same code, conflicting with S-1-2's two-distinct-short-URLs expectation unless salted, which reintroduces collisions.

risks.risk: Open redirect / abuse: any http(s) target is accepted, so the service can be used to mask malicious links.
risks.mitigation: Out of scope per assumptions (no abuse protection in this version); flag for a future requirement.

risks.risk: Code space exhaustion or high collision rate at scale (62^7 ~ 3.5e12).
risks.mitigation: Retry loop; monitor collision frequency; revisit code length if needed.

risks.risk: Unbounded retry loop if store is full or misconfigured.
risks.mitigation: Implementer sets a retry limit and returns a 5xx on exhaustion (limit is an implementer choice per assumptions).

risks.risk: SQLite write contention under concurrent creates.
risks.mitigation: Rely on UNIQUE constraint and short transactions; acceptable for this version's scope.

risks.risk: Host header used to build absolute short URL can be spoofed.
risks.mitigation: Returning a path-only short URL is an allowed alternative per assumptions.

risks.risk: No rate limiting means trivial resource exhaustion.
risks.mitigation: Explicitly out of scope; note for future version.

diagrams.name: Component diagram
diagrams.content:
Client -> HTTP handler -> URL validator
                     -> Code generator -> Link store (SQLite)
                     -> Response builder -> Client

diagrams.name: Create sequence
diagrams.content:
Client -> Handler: POST /links(long_url)
Handler -> Validator: validate(long_url)
Validator --> Handler: ok | 400
Handler -> Generator: new_code()
Generator --> Handler: code
Handler -> Store: insert(code, long_url)
Store --> Handler: ok | collision
Handler -> ResponseBuilder: short_url(code)
ResponseBuilder --> Client: 200 short URL

diagrams.name: Follow sequence
diagrams.content:
Client -> Handler: GET /{code}
Handler -> Store: lookup(code)
Store --> Handler: long_url | not found
Handler --> Client: 302 Location=long_url | 404
